_finding: Owner, 25.11: the server is the one point every verdict passes through, so a switch outside it stops every verdict route when our list disagrees with the issuer. After outside review (25.11): strikes are per chain and only a clean comparison clears them, the probe comes from the issuer's own list, a long silence on our side alerts, a listing we saw first gets its grace, a stale list is unknown, Coinbase is read page by page, odd spellings of a blocked path are blocked, and the state is written only on change.

mutations.name: an issuer outage reads as an empty list
no grace for a delisting
mutations.find: if (t != null && now - t <= GRACE_MS) continue // the issuer delisted it moments ago
mutations.expect: FAIL the issuer delists a token we still list

mutations.name: no grace for a listing we saw first
mutations.expect: FAIL a listing new on our list

mutations.name: a run that compared nothing clears the strikes
mutations.expect: FAIL strikes are per chain, and a run that did not compare does not clear them

mutations.name: no warm-up
mutations.expect: FAIL a fresh start: strikes counted, no trip during the warm-up

mutations.name: the Base prefix is not checked
mutations.find: if (cfg.prefix) for (const a of ours.listed) if (!a.startsWith(cfg.prefix))
mutations.replace: if (false) for (const a of ours.listed) if (!a.startsWith(cfg.prefix))
mutations.expect: FAIL a Base address without the issuer prefix trips

mutations.name: the proof is not checked against our list
mutations.expect: FAIL our list not hashing to the list_proof that names it trips

mutations.name: a stale list is compared
mutations.find: if (p.stale === true) return { state: 'unknown', why: 'our server says its issuer list is stale' }
mutations.expect: FAIL our server saying its own list is stale

mutations.name: the fixed probe only
mutations.find: for (let i = 0; i < PROBE_TRIES && pool.length; i++) probes.push(pool[Math.floor(random() * pool.length)])
mutations.expect: FAIL the probe is drawn from the issuer

mutations.name: the silence on our side is not alerted
mutations.expect: FAIL our side giving nothing to compare while the issuer answers

mutations.name: the state is written every run
mutations.expect: FAIL a quiet hour writes the state at most 10 times

mutations.name: Coinbase read as one page
mutations.expect: FAIL a Coinbase list over several pages is read whole

mutations.name: the path is matched raw
mutations.expect: FAIL ...an odd spelling of a blocked path is blocked too
